en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑storey building with corner pavilions and a central entrance, set behind a landscaped garden and low fence. Curved paths and an open square or park occupy the foreground, with hills visible in the distant background. The reverse side has divided postcard layout, printed Hungarian text and the publisher name.
